marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Corydon and the island of monsters

Banished from his village for being born with a goat's leg. Corydon lives alone in the hills - until he is captured by pirates for their freak show. There he meets other monsters, including Medusa, the Minotaur and the Sphinx. Determined to be free, Corydon steals a magical staff from the pirate captain and leads an escape into the mountains. Dismayed by the monsters' escape Zeus, King of the Gods order his son, Perseus to raise an army of heroes to pursue and kill them. Now they face a devastating battle. Too few to fight it out alone, it seems their fate is sealed - unless Corydon can unravel the mysterious secrets of the staff in time ...
